column3: Saori Route ・ A Brillant Idea
Have him understand my otaku hobby...
I haven't thought of that before, but do you have a plan in mind?
Nope, no idea.
I like that honest facet of yours, Kyousuke-shi.
Then why are you looking away?
Hmm... make him understand, make him understand, make him understand...
Oh, ohhh, ohhhhhh?!
What is it?
A great idea suddenly flashed in my mind.
All right, let's hear it.
Understood!
Wait, she suddenly placed her mouth close to my ear...?
Ah...! T-That's...!
First, I'll need to borrow your help...
M-My ear is getting ticklish...
Next, on Kyousuke-shi's thing, I'll use my good looks...
A-And this feeling...
And using these lips that are pure as a flower bud whetted with morning dew...
This soft feeling on my arm is...?
And curving these long and slender fingers around...
T-This is bad... Completely pierced through my heart...
Kissing the hot and excited body...
...Wait, what kind of things are you saying?
What kind...
I'm making up a scenario to show my otaku soul, where I kiss my collection one at a time...
Is there a problem?
I thought you were reading an erotic story!
Don't do these kinds of dangerous stuff! And pay back the feelings of young men who misunderstood it!
Anyway, I reject! Not accepted!
Is that so...
In my opinion, I was on the right track...
If you overdo it, you will only disgust someone who knows nothing about otaku.
Rather than that, do something more proper.
